decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s existing anamnesis and practice software, the XL package fits strongly with its accumulated knowledge and installed base, so in-house development can refine it further despite its narrower focus on larger practices.

The materials management module builds on the firm’s core workflow expertise and can benefit from learning across many existing customers, but as a newer and less proven add-on its commercial traction is still somewhat more uncertain.

Secure healthcare messaging is tightly linked to the firm’s regulatory, telematics and communication capabilities, and the firm’s high absorptive capacity in health-IT standards makes continued improvement and retention very likely.
